player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''RingBarrer''') posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in September 2001.
description: this is a verry efective deck for draining and retriving.
notes: The byline reads 'none "RingBarrer" none' (no real name given), so the deck is credited to the DeckTech handle RingBarrer with no player page.

No Objective. Dagobah: Yoda's Hut is posted as '(Starting)'; the strategy says the deck starts with Yoda's Hut, Careful Planning and Dagobah: Bog Clearing, so Careful Planning is the starting interrupt. All count toward the 60.
Posted 'Dagobah yoda's hut' dested the printed Light Dagobah: Yoda's Hut (the draft had the (V) page).
Posted 'Sense' dested Sense (Light) (Premiere) and 'Control' dested Control (Dagobah): the author says the deck needs only Premiere and Dagobah packs (plus The Signal).

Spelling fixes: 'Electrobinuculars' Electrobinoculars, 'Traffice control' Traffic Control, 'agression' Anger, Fear, Aggression, 'bith suffle' The Bith Shuffle, 'carfull planning' Careful Planning, 'singnal' The Signal, 'commision' Out Of Commission.
Quantities as published, including 3 of the unique Son Of Skywalker, 10 of the unique Anger, Fear, Aggression and 3 of the unique The Signal.
